policy: Official host behavior is authoritative; native MLX tensor, loader, dtype, compile, cache and stream boundaries are preserved.

inventory.scope: Upstream package version only; retain laya-mlx 0.5.0.
Unreadable or excessively nested policy files report EvalError.

Track answer identity and prediction snapshots before end hooks; preserve original scan spans after reordering, omit edited/cloned/shared attribution, detect missing answers, normalize probabilities in place.
Name invalid target_error values while preserving comparable numeric types.
Routing --explain; BOM-aware questions/batch inputs; path-specific JSON, encoding, depth and OS errors.
Scalar confidence clipping avoids NumPy dispatch while retaining vector entropy order.
Jev probability coercion handles OverflowError.
Validate dataset row shape/read errors, reject bool confidence, require one batch result per row, report incomparable regression metrics.
Explicit accuracy thresholds require the exact metric named.
BOM-aware evidence artifacts and path-specific nesting failures.
Validate timeout coercion and reliability data; preserve full soft stability and NumPy calibration cutoffs; keep semantic labels when renaming empty descriptions.
Validate response/answer/numeric/probability shapes with named malformed-response errors.
Fail closed on malformed remote and nested decisions.
Fail closed on malformed remote and nested decisions.
Reject non-object remote response and answers.
Validate response, choice and ranked probabilities while preserving native port framework compatibility.
Malformed tool decisions/probabilities take the existing error or fallback path.
Unicode letter compatibility table, bisected script ranges, English/Vietnamese heuristics and opt-in diagnostic stage/reason/source paths.
Validate explicit/environment User-Agent and send it on HTTP calls; default uses local package version.
Document LAYA_USER_AGENT.
ONNX implementation excluded; shared long-attribution and probability changes are implemented once in runtime.py.
Reject nested Windows drive-anchored digest paths.
Forward opt-in explain on route/route_batch without changing explicit override routing.
Bound body read time and release admission on 408; hide schema/docs when authenticated; enforce batch token budget even with caller batch size; report invalid tournament labels as 422.
Validate tok/model.encoder before importing the native backend; preserve native MLX embedding.
Reject boolean numeric bounds; ignore non-mapping answer entries during projection/details.

additional_boundary_changes: Agent native imports and public DTYPES resolution are lazy; host-only imports do not load MLX. Native construction and forward still require real MLX.
Cache cleanup avoids importing an unused backend; active native allocations are still cleared via mlx.core.clear_cache.
Native CLI accepts BOM-aware state/questions JSON and reports parsing/read errors before loading a model.
tests/conftest.py imports native fixtures only when needed; macOS CPU device setup remains in pytest_sessionstart.

validation.native_mlx: macOS CPU CI passed: 74 contract tests; 298 native/integration tests, 1 Linux-only skip; full-checkpoint GPU benchmarks not rerun

exclusions: Upstream __version__ bump; no laya-mlx release/version change.
ONNXAgent duplicate and Torch/TileLang/training/backend execution; MLX remains the only inference backend.
Changes outside upstream laya/ (other SDKs, training/research, notebooks, deployment artifacts) are not copied into this Python MLX package.
